description_en: Queries the number of optimizable jobs and the estimated amount of shuffle data that can be saved for a project in a specified analysis batch. You can filter the results by schema and table
description_zh: 查询项目在指定分析批次中可优化的作业数和预估可节省的 Shuffle 数据量。可按 Schema 和表过滤
name: GetAutoClusterEstimatedUtilityByProject

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute table
parameters.name: table

parameters.help_en: The date of the analysis batch, in the yyyyMMdd format. If this parameter is not specified, the latest batch of the corresponding dataset is used
parameters.help_zh: 分析批次日期，格式为 yyyyMMdd。不传时使用对应数据集的最新批次
parameters.name: date

parameters.help_en: The name of the schema to which the table belongs
